preconditions.description: The number of teams n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of wins k must be between 1 and 1000.
The total number of matches must be sufficient for each team to win k times.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if n * (n - 1) // 2 < k * n else True
postconditions.description: If the total number of matches is insufficient, output -1.
The number of matches played must equal k times the number of teams.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in matches)
postconditions.description: Each match must involve two distinct teams numbered from 1 to n.
